chip.description: RGB-output picture processing unit of Nintendo VS. System arcade boards: the 2C02 pipeline with a scrambled palette ROM in place of the NTSC encoder.
chip.notes: src/devices/video/ppu2c0x.cpp in MAME 0.288, device full name "2C04 PPU", implemented as a ppu2c0x_rgb_device alongside the 2C03B. MAME models the 2C04-0001..0004 palette variants with one device plus a supplied palette, so this row stands for the 2C04 family rather than a single suffix.
